text:
zoe: Heads-up — I ran the AB comparison between `rwd-v3p1-int8` (prod) and the new `rwd-v4p0-int4` candidate on the long-doc suite. Quick summary first: latency improved, cost down ~2.3x, but we see small fidelity regressions on the code-help slice. Need alignment on canary gates and fallback thresholds before promoting.

raj: thanks. can you paste the numbers? short is fine.

zoe: Sure. Main signals (all vs prod):
- avg latency P50: -18ms
- avg latency P95: -45ms
- token cost: -57% (est)
- rouge/mrr on doc-rewrite: -0.6% absolute
- hallucination indicator (QA exact-match drop): -0.4% absolute
- code-completion BLEU: -1.8% absolute (spotty on multi-file prompts)

marta: that code BLEU delta worries me. what's the sample size? any conf intervals?

zoe: sample sizes: doc-rewrite N=12k, QA N=8k, code N=2.2k. 95% CI for code BLEU delta ~ ±0.6%. so signal is small but consistent in longer functions and multi-file contexts.

sam: do we have error / hallucination examples? small reproducer would help.

zoe: pasted two repros in the thread. short gist: multi-file import order got dropped, and one example truncated helper function body.

opsbot: smoke tests: all stacks green on staging (latency-only smoke). deploy-bot: ran canary smoke (10k reqs) — no OOMs, KV hit rate normal.

raj: ok. proposal: roll a fractional canary 5% traffic for 24h, monitor 3 buckets: fidelity, hallucination spike, latency tail. fallback triggers: any fidelity metric drop > 1.0% absolute or hallucination increase > 0.5% absolute or P95 latency increase > 25ms. If any trigger, auto-fallback. Thoughts?

marta: fallback numbers seem conservative on fidelity side given code BLEU is -1.8%. but that -1.8 is close to threshold => will trip. Maybe add slice-aware gating: allow overall fidelity delta up to 0.8% if code-slice delta is isolated and below 3.0% and we have mitigation (reranker or prompt tweak).

sam: alternative: keep strict global threshold but add human review hold for first trip on code-slice where delta between 1.0% and 3.0% — don't auto-fallback, instead escalate to @marta/@raj for 1h review window; second breach within 6h => auto-fallback.

zoe: I like that. suggested concrete gating config (will paste as rollout snippet):

```
{
  "canary_fraction": 0.05,
  "duration_hours": 24,
  "metrics": [
    {"name": "fidelity.overall.delta_abs", "threshold": 0.01, "action": "auto-fallback"},
    {"name": "hallucination.qa.delta_abs", "threshold": 0.005, "action": "auto-fallback"},
    {"name": "latency.p95.delta_ms", "threshold": 25, "action": "auto-fallback"},
    {"name": "fidelity.slice.code_bleu.delta_abs", "threshold": 0.03, "action": "escalate-review", "reviewers": ["marta","raj"], "grace_period_mins": 60}
  ]
}
```

marta: that matches my suggestion. add a sampling rule so we capture full context for code-slice failures (upload k-v artifact with stack and prompt).

zoe: added — canary will persist full request/response for 1000 code-slice examples and anonymize PII.

opsbot: note: autoscaler config for canary will reserve 2x baseline GPUs to avoid coldstart skew.

raj: one more ask — add a metric for stochastic regressions: monitor variance of nLL (or token logprob) per session. set soft threshold: variance uplift > 15% triggers alert but not auto-fallback. we should surface that to the model-onboard dashboard.

sam: agreed. also add a quiet-burn phase after 24h: if canary passes, expand to 25% for 12h with same gating, then 100% if still clean.

zoe: updated rollout plan: 5% x24h -> 25% x12h -> promote. gating as above with review flow. I'll create the rollout PR and attach eval artifacts.

marta: please also include a small prompt patch test (2-3 prompts) that can be toggled server-side as mitigation if we see deterministic truncation.

zoe: noted. action items: (1) zoe PR with rollout config + repros + sample artifacts; (2) ops to pin canary capacity; (3) marta/raj to be on-call for review window; (4) sam to add variance metric to dashboard.

raj: sounds good. +1 to the escalation-first approach.

sam: i'll add the dashboard tiles and alert. ETA 6h.

deploy-bot: CI for rollout PR passed. canary job scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

zoe: thanks all. will file the PR and ping when it's ready. :rocket:
